human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Create one deployable TypeScript web application and nothing more. The scaffold exists to support one form, one analysis route and one result page.
human_pressure.why_now: A deployable vertical slice must exist early enough to avoid late hosting surprises.
do_not_misread: This is a 40-hour effective deadline build, not a platform foundation exercise.
Preserve the IDEA → ANALYZE → POTENTIAL GAP → WHY → EVIDENCE → REFINE user loop.
red_lines: No component library unless already present.

machine_core.goal: Create the smallest Next.js App Router scaffold, quality scripts, environment example and initial home page shell.
red_lines: No component library unless already present.
invariants: No secrets exposed to client bundle.

steps.title: Create application scaffold
details: Keep one application; no separate backend service.

steps.title: Create quality scripts
details: Provide lint, test and build scripts.
Use the lightest testing setup compatible with the repo.

steps.title: Create home shell
details: Render product title, tagline, topic input and example topics.

reject_if: Work expands beyond the declared file scope.

validation_notes: Greenfield task suite. Paths are established by earlier packs; run sequentially. Validation commands intentionally use repository-level npm scripts created by the scaffold pack instead of guessed test filenames unless the pack explicitly creates that test file.
expected_coder_final_response: Concise implementation summary, changed files, validation results, and an Evidence Matrix mapping acceptance items to concrete evidence.
